scoring_justification: Headline is a set of three physical constants produced by a computationally expensive MD simulation that the verifier sandbox cannot rerun; acceptable result-level compare with tolerances against paper-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden paper-reported thermal conductivity values for C80H30 at 300K (lambda_x=211, lambda_y=260, lambda_z=229 W/mK) and structural ordering.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and text: 'The obtained values were of 211 W·m⁻¹·K⁻¹ for λx, 260 W·m⁻¹·K⁻¹ for λy and 229 W·m⁻¹·K⁻¹ for λz.'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's exact reported numbers; not fabricated.

outputs.description: Directional thermal conductivities of C80H30 nanographene at 300 K computed from an EMD simulation with the AIREBO potential. The checker compares each value to a hidden reference and also verifies that the ordering lambda_y > lambda_z > lambda_x holds.

output_contract.notes: The checker will use reference_match: the reported directional thermal conductivities will be compared to the paper's reported values with absolute tolerances. Additionally, the known structural ordering λy > λz > λx must be satisfied.

checks.description: Compare lambda_x to paper's reported value 211 W/mK within ±30 W/mK.
Compare lambda_y to paper's reported value 260 W/mK within ±30 W/mK.
Compare lambda_z to paper's reported value 229 W/mK within ±30 W/mK.
